name: RAPID Līmes pistole EG280 12mm
desc: For demanding DIY users and a wide variety of tasks around the house, this high performance glue gun has a handy exchangeable nozzle (available separately) that allows lines and dots of glue to be applied, increasing precision. It also features trigger and handle soft grip for optimal user comfort. An improved feeding mechanism provides high yet smooth glue output of 600 g / hour giving better finished results. The EG280 is supplied with a fixed stand for application in the optimal position.
Soft grip top cover for heating protection
